data: Does the accuracy of the BERT+GRU approach consistently outperform the accuracy of the Prices only approach for all product categories?

The question asks whether the accuracy of the BERT+GRU approach consistently outperforms the accuracy of the Prices-only approach for all product categories. To answer this, I will analyze the performance of these two approaches across the six product categories shown in the figure.

1. **Electronics**: The BERT+GRU line is above the Prices-only line throughout the range of the x-axis, indicating better performance.
2. **Phone**: The BERT+GRU line is above the Prices-only line throughout the range of the x-axis, indicating better performance.

4. **Bike**: The BERT+GRU line is above the Prices-only line throughout the range of the x-axis, indicating better performance.
5. **Furniture**: The BERT+GRU line is above the Prices-only line throughout the range of the x-axis, indicating better performance.
6. **Car**: The BERT+GRU line is above the Prices-only line throughout the range of the x-axis, indicating better performance.

From the analysis of the six product categories, it appears that the BERT+GRU approach consistently outperforms the Prices-only approach. Therefore, the answer to the question is yes.
